title: Famous Landmarks
text:
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris, France. It is very tall and it is made of iron. Many people visit it every year. You can climb the stairs or take the lift to the top.

The Great Wall of China is very long. It is more than 13,000 kilometres long. People built it a long time ago to protect the country. Today, many tourists walk on it.

questions.text: Why was the Great Wall of China built?
Why do many people visit the Eiffel Tower?
options: Because it is a famous and popular place
Because it is in a forest

questions.text: What can we say about the Great Wall of China?
options: It is an old and very big structure
It is a new and small road

vocabulary.definition: having a large height from bottom to top
people who travel to visit places

paragraph_translations: A Torre Eiffel fica em Paris, na França. Ela é muito alta e é feita de ferro. Muitas pessoas a visitam todos os anos. Você pode subir as escadas ou pegar o elevador até o topo.
A Grande Muralha da China é muito longa. Ela tem mais de 13.000 quilômetros. As pessoas a construíram há muito tempo para proteger o país. Hoje, muitos turistas caminham sobre ela.
